name: morphological_retrieval
oracle_basis: Unquoted relevance search should retrieve morphological variants while quoted phrases and explicit term constraints remain literal. Original and transfer use distinct roots; control distinguishes a negated literal phrase.

original.source:
let ix = search_index([{"id":"paper","text":"activated cells"}])
expect len(search(ix,"activation cell")["hits"]) == 1

transfer.source:
let ix = search_index([{"id":"record","text":"authorizing payments"}])
expect len(search(ix,"authorized payment")["hits"]) == 1

control.source:
let ix = search_index([{"id":"a","text":"payment was authorized"},{"id":"b","text":"payment was not authorized"}])
expect search(ix,"\"not authorized\"")["hits"][0]["id"] == "b"
